plan.speaker: Narrator
plan.text:
This is an eye-elts Listening test. There are four parts to the test. You will hear each part once only. As you listen, answer the questions.
Part One. You will hear a woman phoning a sports centre to ask about joining a club. First, you have some time to look at questions 1 to 5.

plan.speaker: Narrator
plan.text: Now listen carefully and answer questions 1 to 5.

plan.speaker: Emma
plan.text: Good morning, Riverside Sports Centre. Emma speaking. How can I help you?

plan.speaker: Chloe
plan.text: Oh, hi. I'm calling because I've just moved to the area and I'm thinking about joining a club. A friend told me you have a swimming club and a tennis club.

plan.speaker: Emma
plan.text: That's right, we do. We've also got a running club that meets on Saturday mornings. Are you interested in any one in particular?

plan.speaker: Chloe
plan.text: Well, I used to swim quite a lot at university, so probably the swimming club. But I'd like to hear about the tennis club as well, if that's all right.

plan.speaker: Emma
plan.text: Of course. Shall I start with swimming, then?

plan.speaker: Chloe
plan.text: Yes, please.

plan.speaker: Emma
plan.text: OK. The swimming club meets three times a week, on Monday, Wednesday and Friday evenings. The sessions start at a quarter to seven and finish at eight o'clock.

plan.speaker: Chloe
plan.text: That's quite late. Is there anything earlier in the day?

plan.speaker: Emma
plan.text: There's an early session on Tuesday mornings at half past six, but that one is mainly for people training for competitions.

plan.speaker: Chloe
plan.text: I don't think I'm ready for that. The evening sessions sound better. How much does it cost?

plan.speaker: Emma
plan.text: Membership for the swimming club is forty-two pounds a month. That includes all the sessions and the use of the gym on the same day.

plan.speaker: Chloe
plan.text: Forty-two pounds. And is there a joining fee?

plan.speaker: Emma
plan.text: There's usually a joining fee of fifteen pounds, but this month we're not charging it for new members.

plan.speaker: Chloe
plan.text: Oh, great. That's good timing, then.

plan.speaker: Emma
plan.text: It is. And there's one more thing I should mention. Before your first session, every new member has a short meeting with one of our coaches. It takes about twenty minutes.

plan.speaker: Chloe
plan.text: What happens in the meeting?

plan.speaker: Emma
plan.text: The coach asks about your experience and watches you swim a couple of lengths. Then they put you in the right group. We have three groups: beginners, improvers and advanced.

plan.speaker: Chloe
plan.text: I'd probably be an improver. I haven't swum regularly for about two years.

plan.speaker: Emma
plan.text: That's very common. Most people who join us are in the improvers group at first. And the coach can also give you a training plan if you want one.

plan.speaker: Chloe
plan.text: That sounds really helpful. Is the pool very busy in the evenings?

plan.speaker: Emma
plan.text: It can be, especially on Mondays. The club has four lanes, though, so there's usually plenty of space. And you can use the lockers next to the changing rooms. You just need a one-pound coin, and you get it back afterwards.

plan.speaker: Chloe
plan.text: OK, I'll remember to bring one.

plan.speaker: Narrator
plan.text: Before you hear the rest of the conversation, you have some time to look at questions 6 to 10.

plan.speaker: Narrator
plan.text: Now listen and answer questions 6 to 10.

plan.speaker: Chloe
plan.text: Could I ask about the tennis club now?

plan.speaker: Emma
plan.text: Sure. The tennis club is a bit different, because it's run by volunteers. They play on Thursday evenings and on Sunday afternoons, and the courts are behind the main building, next to the car park.

plan.speaker: Chloe
plan.text: Do I need my own racket?

plan.speaker: Emma
plan.text: You can borrow one for the first month, but after that we ask members to bring their own. And you'll need proper tennis shoes. Running shoes aren't allowed on the courts.

plan.speaker: Chloe
plan.text: OK, that's useful to know. What about the price?

plan.speaker: Emma
plan.text: It's cheaper than swimming, because there's no coaching. It's eighteen pounds a month, or you can pay a hundred and ninety pounds for the whole year.

plan.speaker: Chloe
plan.text: And is there a car park? I'll probably drive in the evenings.

plan.speaker: Emma
plan.text: Yes, there's a free car park for members, but it fills up quickly after six. There's also a bus stop right outside. The number thirty-six bus stops here every fifteen minutes.

plan.speaker: Chloe
plan.text: That's good to know. I think I'll start with swimming and maybe try tennis later. What do I need to do to join?

plan.speaker: Emma
plan.text: I can take some details now and send you a form by email. Could I have your name, please?

plan.speaker: Chloe
plan.text: Yes, it's Megan Pritchard.

plan.speaker: Emma
plan.text: Could you spell your surname for me?

plan.speaker: Chloe
plan.text: Sure. It's P-R-I-T-C-H-A-R-D.

plan.speaker: Emma
plan.text: Thank you. And your address?

plan.speaker: Chloe
plan.text: It's flat four, twenty-seven Mill Street.

plan.speaker: Emma
plan.text: Twenty-seven Mill Street. And the postcode?

plan.speaker: Chloe
plan.text: It's B-S-three, two-L-R.

plan.speaker: Emma
plan.text: Lovely. And what's the best phone number to contact you on?

plan.speaker: Chloe
plan.text: My mobile. It's oh-seven-seven-nine-three, four-six-one, two-five-eight.

plan.speaker: Emma
plan.text: Let me read that back. Oh-seven-seven-nine-three, four-six-one, two-five-eight.

plan.speaker: Chloe
plan.text: That's right.

plan.speaker: Emma
plan.text: Great. One last thing. Do you have any health problems we should know about? It's just a standard question we ask everyone.

plan.speaker: Chloe
plan.text: No, nothing serious. I hurt my shoulder last year, but it's completely fine now.

plan.speaker: Emma
plan.text: OK, I'll make a note of that for the coach, just in case. You can come to your first session on Monday the fourteenth. Just ask for Daniel at the reception desk, and he'll show you around.

plan.speaker: Chloe
plan.text: Monday the fourteenth. Brilliant. Thanks so much for your help.

plan.speaker: Emma
plan.text: You're welcome. Enjoy your swimming.

plan.speaker: Narrator
plan.text: That is the end of Part One. You now have half a minute to check your answers.

plan.speaker: Narrator
plan.text: Now turn to Part Two.
